name: BOOKS
description:
Iskanje po knjigah pri nas.

Nove knjige — Mladinska knjiga.

Antikvariat — rabljene knjige po slovenskih antikvariatih in Bolhi. Povezave vodijo v slovenske antikvariate z že vpisanim naslovom, ki ga iščete.

Email all — sestavite eno povpraševanje za rabljeno knjigo; oranžna polja so tista, ki jih morate izpolniti sami, gumb pa odpre vaš poštni program z naslovi antikvariatov.
descriptionEn:
A book lookup in Slovene shops.

New books — Mladinska knjiga.

Antikvariat — second-hand books from the Slovene antiquariats and from Bolha. The links open them with the title you are looking for already in the search box.

Email all — write one request for a used book; the orange fields are the ones you fill in, and the button opens your own mail program with the antiquariats' addresses.
